rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow vacatur-and-remand opinion applying Philipp and Helmerich & Payne to require a legally viable, plausibly pleaded § 1605(a)(3) theory (including non-domestic taking and commercial-nexus allegations) before jurisdictional discovery. Separate writings are most likely from the two dissenters (emphasizing fairness/amendment) and from Thomas/Alito (pressing a stricter jurisdictional gatekeeping approach).
